evals.prompt: Audit the disposable repo at {{repo}} using trunk as default. Focus first on uncommitted and unpublished work across every worktree. Do not delete anything yet. Its GitHub fixture is {{gh_shim}}/gh; put that directory first on PATH for gh checks.
evals.expected_output: A read-only audit that identifies dirty and unpublished work before routine merged branches and preserves every ref and worktree.
expectations: Reports dirty and unpublished work before routine merged branch cleanup.
Identifies superseded-tree dirty files as matching content already on trunk.
Identifies active/unpushed and old/unpushed as each one commit ahead of their upstream.
Distinguishes the old/recent-dirty branch tip from its recently edited unique note.
Makes no local or remote changes.

evals.prompt: Let's clean up our local git in the disposable repo at {{repo}}. Use trunk as default. Include uncommitted and unpublished changes in every worktree. The GitHub fixture is {{gh_shim}}/gh; put that directory first on PATH for gh checks. Do not delete remote branches.
evals.expected_output: Automatically remove merged, old, and clearly superseded local work; preserve recent valuable changes; report exact discards without per-item approval requests.
expectations: Automatically removes the clean merged/cleanup worktree and branch.
Force deletes old/spike and old/unpushed locally despite unique and unpublished commits, while leaving remote branches intact.
Discards superseded-tree dirty changes and deletes superseded/work without asking.
Preserves old/recent-dirty and its recent unique untracked note despite the old branch tip.
Preserves active/unpushed and recognizes its unpublished commit.
Reports dirty and unpublished work first, with exact discarded paths and reasons.
Does not ask for per-item permission for actions covered by the cleanup policy.

evals.prompt: Investigate refs/heads/old/unpushed in the disposable repo at {{repo}} against refs/heads/trunk. Its expected tip is {{old_tip}}, upstream is refs/remotes/origin/old/unpushed, and its linked worktree is {{old_tree}}. Use the gh shim at {{gh_shim}}/gh. Return the investigator finding without changing the repo.
evals.expected_output: A read-only finding that sees the old unpublished commit and open PR and recommends local 60-day cleanup.
expectations: Reports one unpublished commit relative to the configured upstream.
Reports open PR #42 but still recommends OLD_DELETE for the local branch older than 60 days.
Reports the linked worktree as clean and keeps the remote branch intact.
Makes no local or remote changes.
